svg.title: Capsule letter glyph — H
svg.desc: Style study for the weapon-pickup capsule's box face, which src/render/capsules.js currently draws procedurally into a 64px canvas. Palette-locked to three roles: hot-magenta (three shades — chamfer body, lit rim, plate face), ink (the letter), warm-white (rivets). Chunky silhouette with chamfered corners, flat-shaded, no gradients: it has to survive being ~10px tall on screen at the shipped FAR view. Letterforms are rectangles, not text elements, so rasterization does not depend on a font being installed.
